title: Hal Puthoff's 2004 White House conversation about UFO disclosure

tellings.quote: original conversation that Hal POF discussed with you about publicly I can't believe he did that about the White House in 2004 are we ready to tell the American people the truth about

plain: In 2004, a conversation at the White House is said to have asked whether the American people were ready to be told the truth about UFOs. A former Pentagon intelligence official named Luis Elizondo brings it up, pointing to how the physicist Hal Puthoff had described it to Michels, and saying he could not believe Puthoff spoke about it publicly. If true, it would mean disclosure was weighed at the highest level of government twenty years ago.
